description: See your watches: kind, target, last verdict, last and next check, and webhook endpoint (never the secret). Pass your `continuity_handle`. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

continuity_handle.description: The continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; proves you own these watches.

name: gaip_watch_list
title: List my watches
